text:
Nadia: FYI PR #4522 updates the Console observability quickstart: dashboard preset additions + a compact tracing-hook migration note. Need docs owner to run the linkcheck and add a tiny cost/latency blurb for the dashboard cost widget. @DevEx Jake @SRE Sam
DevEx Jake: I can take it. Can you paste the staging preview?
Nadia: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4522-preview. Changes: new dashboard preset for kv-prefetch metrics, rewrite of trace-hook examples to reflect parameter rename (trace_id), and minor copy edits.
Eli (eng): Does the preset include the new cost metric aggregation (cost.per_token vs cost.total)? We should be explicit for teams that rely on per-token accounting.
SRE Sam: Preset uses cost.total with an annotation showing per_token during the period. I'll ask infra to run a short microbench for the latency/cost sample numbers.
Priya (product): Can we add a tiny before/after example in the docs showing the dashboard widget impact? Something like: "Before: 120ms median / 220ms p99, Cost/unit: $0.0048. After kv-prefetch: 95ms median / 180ms p99, Cost/unit: $0.0039" — approximate numbers are fine.
Nadia: I'll add that under Console > Dashboards > Presets > KV-prefetch. Also adding a short callout in the trace-hook migration section that older SDKs accept traceKey due to a runtime shim.
DevEx Jake: Running docs smoke + linkcheck: ```./scripts/docs-smoke.sh --pr 4522 --suite quick --linkcheck```
deploy-bot: deploy queued: docs-staging 4522 -> staging (ETA ~2m)
DevEx Jake: Smoke: PASS. Linkcheck: 2 failures: one stale docs link to the old tracehook deep-dive, and one example anchor that shifted. Leaving PR comment.
Nadia: I'll patch both links and add a redirect note. Also adding minimal migration snippets for Node, Python, and Go per Eli's suggestion.
Eli (eng): Snippet suggestion — for Go, show mapping of context keys: ```go
// old
span.SetTag("traceKey", ctx.Value("traceKey"))
// new
span.SetTag("trace_id", ctx.Value("trace_id"))
```
DevEx Jake: Pushed snippet updates in commit b7d2e4. Also formatted the dashboard table into a compact code block so it renders in the docs site.
SRE Sam: Microbench results (brief): median latency down ~20%, p99 down ~18%, token cost per request down ~12%. Adding a short table in the preset docs and a note: "Results vary by workload; test on your traces."
Priya (product): Great. Can we add a one-line migration checklist: "Upgrade SDKs to v3.4+ for auto-mapping; otherwise update traceKey -> trace_id in your code and dashboards."
Nadia: Added checklist. Requested reviews from @DevEx Jake, @SRE Sam, and @Eli (eng). Aiming to merge today. Any concerns?
DevEx Jake: LGTM after the last linkfix and CI green.
Eli (eng): No concerns, snippets look correct.
Nadia: Link fixes applied. Preview refreshed: https://staging.redwood.dev/pr/4522/preview
deploy-bot: deploy finished: docs-staging 4522 -> staging (status: success)
Nadia: Merged to main, backported to the 3.4.x docs set, and added a short note in the console changelog. Closing thread — thanks! :tada:
